items.title: BioWare's end is a tragically familiar tale | Opinion
items.en_title: BioWare's end is a tragically familiar tale | Opinion
items.en_oneliner: The commentary argues BioWare's end is another familiar tragedy in five years of industry layoffs and closures, worth practitioners' reflection on the creative cost of big-studio acquisitions.

items.en_title: GameMaker to make its "next-generation runtime" GMRT free for commercial use in January 2027
items.en_oneliner: GameMaker announced its next-generation runtime GMRT will be free for commercial use from January 2027, good news for 2D developers.

items.title: Nintendo veteran Shigeru Miyamoto to receive Japan's Order of Culture award
items.en_title: Nintendo veteran Shigeru Miyamoto to receive Japan's Order of Culture award
items.en_oneliner: Shigeru Miyamoto will become the first game developer to receive Japan's Order of Culture, an honor marking game creation's rising status in mainstream culture.

items.title: Roll dice and make it big in ‘Influencer Solitaire’
items.en_title: Roll dice and make it big in ‘Influencer Solitaire’
items.en_oneliner: Influencer Solitaire turns being an influencer into a dice-rolling card game, light-hearted and a little satirical, suited to developers who like small-scale creative ideas.

items.en_title: Capcom affected by data breach, over 11.7m Capcom ID accounts compromised
items.en_oneliner: Capcom suffered a data breach affecting over 11.7 million Capcom ID accounts, and players should watch account security.

items.en_title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 | Critical Consensus

items.en_title: GMRT Update Free for Commercial Use and Source Access
items.en_oneliner: GameMaker's next-generation runtime is now free for commercial use and open source, letting developers modify and adapt the technology more freely, a useful reference when evaluating engines.

items.title: Opinion: Why words matter when we prioritize 'core teams' in game development
items.en_title: Opinion: Why words matter when we prioritize 'core teams' in game development
items.en_oneliner: This opinion piece reminds developers that wording about core teams shapes the development process, and language downplaying other members may quietly devalue their contributions.
